# MethodSpec Audit: cooper_gulen_schill_2008_asset_growth

## Verdict

- review_status: revision_required
- remediation_mode: patch_existing_json
- codegen_ready: no
- paper_faithful: no
- confidence: medium

## Executive Summary

The core economic target is plausible: the paper’s main signal is annual asset growth based on Compustat item 6, formed each June and held from July of year t to June of year t+1. However, the submitted JSON is not parser-safe or codegen-safe. It mixes legacy schema with the current parser contract, omits required top-level sections (`paper`, `sample`, `timing`, `universe`), and leaves three high-impact executable choices unresolved: accounting lag, decile breakpoint universe, and the main weighting variant (EW vs VW). Reported results are directionally sensible, but several source objects are too weak to fully support the stored metrics.

Note: this environment is read-only, so this report could not be written to `annotations/<factor_id> - MethodSpec Audit.md`, and `CHANGELOG.md` could not be updated.

## Critical Issues

| Severity | Field path | Issue | Paper evidence | Recommended fix | Patch confidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| P0 | `paper` | Required top-level paper object is missing; legacy metadata is not enough for parser contract. | Paper title and section structure are explicit across the paper. | Add structured `paper.title`, `paper.citation`, `paper.pdf_file`, `paper.paper_sections`, `paper.evidence_sections`. | high |
| P0 | `sample` | Required structured sample section is missing; `sample_start_year`/`sample_end_year` do not encode formation vs return sample. | "we start all of our portfolio tests ... in the end of June 1968"; Table II caption: "July 1968 to June of 2003." | Replace legacy scalar years with structured `sample.formation_years` and `sample.return_sample`. | high |
| P0 | `timing` | Required top-level timing section is missing; timing facts are nested under `signal.timing`. | "At the end of June of each year t ... portfolios are formed from July of year t to June of year t+1." | Normalize timing into stable top-level timing fields. | high |
| P0 | `universe` | Required top-level universe section is missing; free-text `portfolio.universe` is not machine-safe. | "We use all NYSE, Amex, and NASDAQ nonfinancial firms ..." | Add structured `universe.description`, `exchange_names`, `filters`, `missing_policy`, `winsorize_bounds`. | high |
| P0 | `ambiguous_fields[*].status` | Schema-invalid: uses `source` instead of required `status`. | Parser contract requires `status`. | Convert each item to valid `status` values and keep rationale/evidence. | high |
| P0 | `signal.formula.inputs` | Required stable formula-input field is missing. | Equation (1) uses total assets only. | Add `signal.formula.inputs: ["total_assets"]`. | high |
| P1 | `signal.timing.accounting_lag` | High-impact executable lag is unresolved; paper does not state a single month-lag integer. | "we form all of our accounting variables at the end of June in year t, using accounting information from fiscal year-end t−1" | Keep ambiguous and require human approval before codegen. | medium |
| P1 | `portfolio.sort.breakpoint_source` | Main decile breakpoint universe is paper-silent and materially affects replication. | Paper states decile sorts, but only size groups explicitly use NYSE breakpoints. | Keep unresolved and require human approval before codegen. | medium |
| P1 | `reported_results.return_calculation.portfolio_return.weighting` | Main executable variant is unclear because both EW and VW are main paper outputs. | "we calculate monthly returns for EW and VW portfolios" | Require human selection of one executable target or split into separate MethodSpecs. | medium |

## Human Review Questions
